title: Flaky: AzureSqlPrincipalReconciliationTests fail because SqlServerContainerFixture cannot bind port 1433 (address already in use)
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure, tests/Aspire... / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
error_pattern: Class fixture type 'Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests.SqlServerContainerFixture' threw in InitializeAsync ---- Docker.DotNet.DockerApiException : Docker API responded with status code=InternalServerError, response={"message":"failed to set up container networking: driver failed programming external connectivity on endpoint bold_newton: failed to bind host port for 0.0.0.0::172.17.0.3:1433/tcp: address already in use"}
analysis: All failures occur in the shared SqlServerContainerFixture.InitializeAsync when Docker tries to bind host port 1433 for the SQL Server test container, and it is already in use by another process/container on the shared CI runner. This is a well-known port contention issue on shared Linux runners, unrelated to any application code. The PR under test only modifies MongoDB hosting code and does not touch Azure SQL, Docker container fixtures, or port allocation logic, confirming this is not caused by the PR changes.
